description: Send a typed IM to another avatar anywhere on the city server (they need not be on your lot). Delivery is server-routed through `InstantMessageHandler`; your client-side ACK completion arrives as an `InstantMessage` with `Type=SUCCESS_ACK` or `Type=FAILURE_ACK` (with `Reason`). Costs nothing; fails if recipient is offline, ignoring you, or their message queue is full.
